name: datacenter-80gb
provenance: Uncalibrated approximation of a current datacenter accelerator class (80 GB HBM3, ~3.35 TB/s, ~495 TFLOPS dense BF16). Figures are published vendor peaks for the device class, NOT measurements, and dense rather than sparsity-doubled. The mfu/bw_eff/link_eff factors are rules of thumb, not fits. Replace via tools/calibrate_cost_model.py.
